name: Embewi ESP32 Rust
postCreateCommand: bash -lc '. /opt/esp/export-esp.sh && rustc --version && cargo --version && espup --version && espflash --version && esp-generate --version'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'mkdir -p /workspace/web; [ -f /tmp/http-server.pid ] && kill $(cat /tmp/http-server.pid) 2>/dev/null; nohup setsid /usr/local/bin/http-server /workspace/web -p 8080 -c-1 > /tmp/http-server.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! > /tmp/http-server.pid; exit 0'
